question: What was New York's chronic liver disease mortality rate in 2019? (A) 12.0 per 100k (B) 8.6 per 100k (C) 10.5 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: B (8.6 per 100k). Bait: C (10.5 per 100k).
